settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure request affinity and key-based routing behavior

affinity.title: Request affinity
affinity.description: Keep matching requests on the same provider while a valid affinity key is available.
affinity.enabledHelp: When disabled, the gateway skips affinity lookup and writes.
affinity.ttlHelp: How long an affinity assignment remains valid unless a rule overrides it.

rules.title: Affinity rules
rules.description: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom. Add, remove, or drag rules to change their order.
rules.orderHelp: The first enabled rule whose matchers pass and whose ordered sources produce a valid key wins. Empty match fields match every request. If no rule produces a key, the gateway falls back to normal routing. A rule TTL of 0 inherits the global TTL.
rules.empty: No affinity rules. Add a rule to configure matching.

rule.name: Rule name
rule.matchDescription: Leave a matcher empty to match all requests.
rule.modelPatternHelp: Regular expression tested against the requested model.
rule.pathPatternHelp: Regular expression tested against the API path.
rule.userAgentHelp: Case-insensitive substring matched against the User-Agent header.
rule.valuePatternHelp: Regular expression applied to each candidate value before it can win.
rule.sourcesDescription: Sources are tried in order; the first valid value wins.
rule.derivedKey: Uses the gateway's current derived-key fallback.
rule.noSources: No key sources. Add one to let this rule produce a key.
